title: riley-nguyen-private-deploy-scratchpad-2026-03-03
content:
Daily scratchpad / field notes - Private deployments (VPC / on-prem)
Date: 2026-03-03
Owner: Riley Nguyen
Context: prepping for two upcoming customer installs (Customer A: enterprise VPC in AWS w/ KMS; Customer B: on-prem air-gapped appliance). Notes are messy - quick capture for follow-ups.

---- SUMMARY / ACTIONS ----
- Customer A (AWS VPC): need final network diagram from their infra team + KMS key policy. Blocker: security wants HSM-backed key for production (raised with sales/security). To do: schedule cert handoff call w/ infra (Evelyn) 2026-03-05.
- Customer B (on-prem, air-gapped): initial bake of image works, but proxy config and internal registry access failing. Blocker: customer firewall blocks outbound to our artifact mirror. Need customer sysadmin to run preflight checklist and open required ports to internal mirror or provide offline artifact bundle.
- Prep checklist for both: gpu driver + CUDA compatibility, container runtime (containerd vs docker), nvidia-container-toolkit, kernel version >= 5.10 recommended, glibc compat.

---- QUICK TODO (next 48h) ----
- [ ] Finalize Customer A network diagram (Evelyn)
- [ ] Create HSM integration doc stub for security review (Riley)
- [ ] Produce offline artifact tarball for Customer B (use chef/bundles)
- [ ] Run preflight on bare-metal node (nv-srv-02) and capture dmesg + nvidia-smi output
- [ ] Confirm helm chart values for private-registry auth (username in vault? -> ask Priya)

---- INSTALL / PRE-FLIGHT NOTES (copyable) ----
Prereqs:
- Kernel: >=5.10 (RHEL 8.6 / Ubuntu 22.04 preferred)
- GPU driver: NVIDIA 535.x tested with CUDA 12.1 (match with model runtime), install BEFORE container runtime
- Container runtime: containerd 1.7.x or Docker 24.x with nvidia-container-toolkit
- nvidia-container-toolkit: install + restart container runtime
- helm >= 3.8
- kubernetes: tested on 1.27 and 1.28 for our runtime (confirm exact k8s compatibility matrix)
- Open ports: 22 (ssh), 443 (control plane), 50051 (grpc), 9090 (metrics), 2379-2380 (etcd) if using local etcd

Commands I ran locally (use as reference):
- nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,index,memory.total --format=csv
- sudo apt-get install -y nvidia-driver-535
- curl -fsSL https://get.helm.sh/helm-v3.10.0-linux-amd64.tar.gz | tar xz && sudo mv linux-amd64/helm /usr/local/bin/helm
- sudo systemctl restart containerd && journalctl -u containerd -n 200 --no-pager

Helm install (values to confirm):
helm upgrade --install redwood-runtime redwood/redwood-runtime -f values.yaml --set imagePullSecrets[0].name=private-reg-cred --namespace redwood

values.yaml notes:
- image.repository: "internal.registry.company.com/redwood"
- image.tag: "release-2026-02-25"
- registry.authSecret: "redwood-registry-creds"

---- AIR-GAPPED / PROXY / REGISTRY CONSIDERATIONS ----
- Customer B blocks outbound. Options:
  - Provide full offline bundle (images + tarred artifacts + charts) and documented install steps.
  - Set up local registry mirror (recommended) -> customer provides URL and auth.
  - If proxy is required, ensure our installer supports HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY and auth headers.
- Certs: we need customer TLS cert for control plane (server cert) OR advise using their internal CA. Provide cert CSR flow.
- KMS/HSM: Customer A prefers HSM. Need to document key wrapping flow and ensure our key manager supports their HSM vendor (Thales/Entrust/etc.). Security asked for PKCS#11 integration doc.

---- BLOCKERS / RISKS ----
- Security sign-off pending for HSM integration (Customer A) -> blocks prod cutover
- Customer B internal firewall blocking artifact mirror (blocks initial image pull)
- Inconsistent kernel/glibc on customer's fleet -> may require building custom runtime image for compatibility
- License compliance: GPU drivers / CUDA versions require separate customer acceptance (notify procurement)

---- NOTES FROM CALL w/ CUSTOMER B (2026-03-02) ----
- They run a locked-down air-gapped environment; standard apt repos are not available.
- Have an internal container registry at 10.1.2.3:5000 that requires basic auth.
- Will provide jump host for initial install and will require offline verification steps.
- Action: produce a signed PKCS12 bundle for their ops team and include step-by-step for cert import.

---- NEXT STEPS / FOLLOW-UPS ----
- Draft HSM integration stub + PKCS#11 example by 2026-03-04 (Riley)
- Build offline artifact bundle and test on local air-gapped VM (customer B) by 2026-03-06 (Priya to help)
- Schedule joint install runbook review with customer infra & security (include Evelyn + Priya)

---- RANDOM TODO / NOTES TO SELF ----
- Check internal runbook: confluence link above -> update CPU/GPU sizing table for new 537 model testing
- Log detailed errors from failed helm install and attach to DEPLOY-342
- Remember to ask sales to confirm expected RTO/RPO for Customer A (affects HA config)

End of scratchpad. Will refine into a cleaned install-runbook after blockers resolved.
